description: This file defines the SmsHandler class, which manages SMS-related operations such as sending and searching SMS messages, utilizing an SmsManager. It processes results and constructs appropriate GatewaySession.InvokeResult objects based on success or failure.

classes.name: SmsHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling SMS operations via the SmsManager, providing methods for sending and searching SMS messages and generating appropriate results.

methods.name: handleSmsSend
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an SMS message based on provided JSON parameters and returns the result encapsulating success or failure.

methods.name: handleSmsSearch
methods.description: Asynchronously searches for SMS messages based on provided JSON parameters and returns the result encapsulating success or failure.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs an error result with a specific error code and message based on input parameters.
